name: 3d-modeling
description: Create, validate and export 3D models: parametric code CAD (build123d), Blender scripting, Autodesk Fusion and AI mesh generation, with headless previews and mesh checks.

interface.longDescription: Turns a description, sketch or reference image into checked STEP, STL, 3MF, OBJ, GLB or .blend files using code CAD, Blender, Fusion or AI mesh generation.
defaultPrompt: Use $3d-modeling to design a wall mount for a 60 x 40 mm sensor with two M3 screw holes.
Use $3d-modeling to make a name keychain that says Andrea.
Use $3d-modeling to check this STL and render previews from four sides.
